terminals.name: one-api
terminals.command: cd /workspace && bash ./.cursor/start.sh && export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH && go run ./cmd/api
terminals.description: Ensures Postgres is up, then runs the Platform API on :8080 (loads .env, applies migrations, seeds core packages)

terminals.name: one-worker
terminals.command: cd /workspace && until sudo -u postgres pg_isready -q; do sleep 1; done && export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH && go run ./cmd/worker
terminals.description: Waits for Postgres, then runs the background worker: automations, outbox/webhooks, projections
